package main
import("bytes";"compress/gzip";"crypto/sha256";"encoding/hex";"encoding/json";"fmt";"io";"os";"path/filepath";"github.com/k0ngk0ng/wire-board/games/yuyuhakusho/engine";"github.com/k0ngk0ng/wire-board/games/yuyuhakusho/runtimebridge")
func asset(n string)[]byte{b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("games/yuyuhakusho/data",n+".json.gz"));if e!=nil{panic(e)};z,e:=gzip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(b));if e!=nil{panic(e)};defer z.Close();b,e=io.ReadAll(z);if e!=nil{panic(e)};return b}
func hash(b []byte)string{s:=sha256.Sum256(b);return hex.EncodeToString(s[:])}
func main(){rows:=[]any{};for _,arena:=range []uint16{0,10}{name:="arena-assets-default";var aux []byte;if arena!=0{name=fmt.Sprintf("arena-assets-%x",arena);aux=asset("arena-a-aux-assets")};a,e:=runtimebridge.DecodeAssetsForArena(asset("chu-world-rules"),asset("world-sprites"),asset(name),asset("hud-assets"),aux,arena);if e!=nil{panic(e)};o:=engine.ChuSessionOptions{Arena:arena,Seed:0x12345678,Difficulty:6,Players:[]engine.ChuSessionPlayer{{Slot:0,CharacterID:7,Color:0,Computer:true},{Slot:3,CharacterID:9,Color:1,Computer:true}}};s,e:=runtimebridge.NewSession(o,a);if e!=nil{panic(e)};save:=func(mark string){b,e:=s.Save();if e!=nil{panic(e)};rows=append(rows,map[string]any{"arena":arena,"mark":mark,"tick":s.View().Tick,"sha256":hash(b),"bytes":len(b)})};save("prepared");if e=s.Ready();e!=nil{panic(e)};save("ready");for tick:=1;tick<=600;tick++{_,e=s.Step([8]engine.Buttons{});if e!=nil{panic(e)};if tick==1||tick==240||tick==600{save(fmt.Sprint(tick))}}};raw,_:=json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"schema":1,"scope":"Existing schema1 bytes before schema2 implementation; original assets exact raw JSON","rows":rows},"","  ");os.Stdout.Write(append(raw,'\n'))}
